targets.rawSql: SELECT * FROM (SELECT country, sum(requests) AS requests FROM cdnf.edge_traffic_1m WHERE $__timeFilter(interval_start) AND dateDiff('second', $__fromTime, $__toTime) BETWEEN 0 AND 172800 AND $__conditionalAll(region IN (${region:singlequote}), $region) AND $__conditionalAll(pop IN (${pop:singlequote}), $pop) AND $__conditionalAll(edge_id IN (${edge:singlequote}), $edge) AND $__conditionalAll(domain_id IN (${domain:csv}), $domain) GROUP BY country UNION ALL SELECT country, sum(requests) AS requests FROM cdnf.edge_traffic_hourly WHERE $__timeFilter(interval_start) AND dateDiff('second', $__fromTime, $__toTime) BETWEEN 172801 AND 34560000 AND $__conditionalAll(region IN (${region:singlequote}), $region) AND $__conditionalAll(pop IN (${pop:singlequote}), $pop) AND $__conditionalAll(edge_id IN (${edge:singlequote}), $edge) AND $__conditionalAll(domain_id IN (${domain:csv}), $domain) GROUP BY country UNION ALL SELECT country, sum(requests) AS requests FROM cdnf.edge_traffic_daily WHERE $__timeFilter(interval_start) AND dateDiff('second', $__fromTime, $__toTime) BETWEEN 34560001 AND 10000000000 AND $__conditionalAll(region IN (${region:singlequote}), $region) AND $__conditionalAll(pop IN (${pop:singlequote}), $pop) AND $__conditionalAll(edge_id IN (${edge:singlequote}), $edge) AND $__conditionalAll(domain_id IN (${domain:csv}), $domain) GROUP BY country) ORDER BY requests DESC LIMIT 10
